version-level visualization owns human-readable projection，不拥有 canonical truth。

tasks.title: FR-012 Design review 必须保持 support surface 边界
tasks.description: `beacon-design-review` 不能直接写 canonical truth、不能给 release verdict、不能替代 `ui-ux-dev review` 或 `beacon-change`。 ## 6. Business Flow ```mermaid flowchart TD A[UI/UX or version visualization need] --> B{Need type} B -->|UI/UX execution| C[ui-ux-dev intent router] B -->|Beacon requirement governance| D[Beacon truth surfaces] C --> E[explore/system/review/polish/extract/library] E --> F{Accepted output changes requirement?} F -->|No| G[Advisory retained outside truth] F -->|Yes| H[Prototype adapter binding] H --> I[PRD / user-story / test-case update or obligation] D --> J[Business flow / state-machine / map projection] I --> K[Requirement clarity gate] J --> K K -->|pass| L[Freeze/refreeze] K -->|blocked| M[Route back to change / truth surface] ``` ## 7. State Machine ```mermaid stateDiagram-v2 [*] --> route_classified route_classified --> ui_ux_external_route: UI/UX execution route_classified --> beacon_truth_route: requirement governance ui_ux_external_route --> design_result_advisory design_result_advisory --> design_result_accepted design_result_accepted --> adapter_binding_pending adapter_binding_pending --> adapter_binding_blocked: truth bindings missing adapter_binding_pending --> adapter_binding_ready beacon_truth_route --> visualization_projection_pending visualization_projection_pending --> visualization_blocked: projection bindings missing visualization_projection_pending --> clarity_ready adapter_binding_ready --> clarity_ready clarity_ready --> frozen frozen --> implement_ready adapter_binding_blocked --> change_required visualization_blocked --> change_required ``` ## 8. 验收标准 AC-001 Beacon stops treating internal UI/UX execution as a future core capability. AC-002 Beacon routes UI/UX execution intent to `ui-ux-dev`. AC-003 Beacon does not silently fallback to internal design generation when `ui-ux-dev` is unavailable. AC-004 Beacon redefines `prototype` as a design-result adapter. AC-005 Beacon blocks implementation when accepted design results lack truth bindings. AC-006 Beacon keeps historical prototype bundles readable without making them v1.4.9 execution truth. AC-007 Beacon defines version-level business flow projection. AC-008 Beacon defines version-level state-machine projection. AC-009 Beacon defines version-level PRD / user-story / test-case map projection. AC-010 Beacon requires truth bindings for every version-level projection. AC-011 Requirement clarity blocks when required visualization bindings are missing. AC-012 Beacon keeps `beacon-design-review` as route / governance support, not a truth source or UI/UX execution substitute. ## 9. 边界 / 分层 / 恢复策略 ### 9.1 边界 Beacon 的边界是 requirement governance，不是 UI/UX execution。`ui-ux-dev` 的边界是 UI/UX execution，不是 Beacon truth source。 ### 9.2 分层 本需求按三层闭合： Requirement truth layer：PRD、user-story、test-case、research、source-architecture。 Projection layer：business flow、state-machine、PRD / user-story / test-case map。 Runtime evidence layer：implement、QA、release 后续产生的过程、session、evidence、trace。 Projection layer 只能解释 truth，不能新增 truth。 ### 9.3 恢复策略 当 `ui-ux-dev` 缺失、adapter binding 缺失、projection truth bindings 缺失或历史 prototype bundle 被误用为 v1.4.9 execution truth 时，Beacon 必须阻断并恢复到对应治理路径： UI/UX execution 缺失：恢复到 `ui-ux-dev-bootstrap` 或明确提示安装/调用外部 skill。 Adapter binding 缺失：恢复到 `beacon-prototype` adapter writeback 或 `beacon-change`。 Projection truth bindings 缺失：恢复到 PRD、user-story、test-case 或 research 补齐。 历史 prototype 语义漂移：恢复到 compatibility-only 读取，不允许作为新 execution truth。 ## 10. 风险与缓解 | 风险 | 影响 | 缓解 | | --- | --- | --- | | Beacon 继续被当作 UI/UX 生成器 | 生命周期职责膨胀，需求治理变弱 | 明确 `ui-ux-dev` owns UI/UX execution，Beacon 只保留 adapter 和 gate | | Accepted design result 未进入 truth binding | 实现按设计印象推进，需求不可追溯 | implement gate 阻断缺失 adapter binding | | 可视化图被当作 truth | 人类说明图覆盖三件套 truth | 每张 projection 必须声明 truth bindings，且不得新增要求 | | 历史 prototype bundle 被误判为 v1.4.9 truth | 旧材料绕过新边界 | 历史 bundle 只兼容读取，不能定义新 execution ownership | | `ui-ux-dev` 不可用时静默 fallback | 重新产生 Beacon 内建设计执行面 | 缺失 upstream 时恢复到 bootstrap，不允许 silent fallback | ## 11. Decision Priority 1. `ui-ux-dev` owns UI/UX execution. 2. Beacon owns requirement truth and gates. 3. Accepted design result must be bound before implementation. 4. Projection without truth bindings is invalid. 5. Historical compatibility must not override v1.4.9 ownership. ## 12. Diagram Truth Layer ### 12.1 Diagram Types `branch-flow` `state-machine` `decision-priority` ### 12.2 State Axes `ui_ux_route` `adapter_binding` `requirement_visualization` `truth_binding` ### 12.3 Propagation Contract Diagram truth must stay explicit through freeze readiness, implementation planning, and QA coverage. State axes must not be silently compressed into one implicit status field. ## 13. 冻结交付物 `docs/beacon/v1.4.9/research/ui-ux-externalization-prototype-adapter-and-version-visualization-contract.md` `docs/beacon/v1.4.9/source-architecture/ui-ux-externalization-prototype-adapter-and-version-visualization-contract.md` `docs/beacon/v1.4.9/change/ui-ux-externalization-prototype-adapter-and-version-visualization-contract.md` `docs/beacon/v1.4.9/prd/ui-ux-externalization-prototype-adapter-and-version-visualization-contract.md` `docs/beacon/v1.4.9/user-story/ui-ux-externalization-prototype-adapter-and-version-visualization-contract.md` `docs/beacon/v1.4.9/qa/test-cases/ui-ux-externalization-prototype-adapter-and-version-visualization-contract.md` ## 14. 成功指标 Human-facing Beacon lifecycle becomes smaller and clearer. UI/UX work has one stable external route. Accepted design outputs still enter Beacon truth through explicit bindings. Version-level requirement packages become easier to understand without weakening canonical truth.
